itemOffered.name: Morning Cruise
itemOffered.description: Start your day on calm, glassy waters with a refreshing morning sail on Lake Tahoe — complete with complimentary drinks and our signature mimosas.

itemOffered.name: High Noon Cruise
itemOffered.description: Soak up the sunshine on a vibrant midday sail across Lake Tahoe, complete with complimentary drinks and wide-open alpine views.

itemOffered.name: Afternoon Cruise
itemOffered.description: Unwind on a relaxed afternoon sail across Lake Tahoe with complimentary drinks, mountain views, and sunshine stretching into golden hour.

itemOffered.name: Sunset Cruise
itemOffered.description: Sail into golden hour on Lake Tahoe with champagne skies, mountain reflections, good company, and a glass in hand as the sun melts into the horizon.
